title: Universal Protected Script Fetcher
features:
Basically gets what's inside the URL (Luarmor, Panda Development and Junkie API)

Since you can't view them as they we'll just say "Unauthorized Access!"

This is good if you want to look into script URLs that are Protected (just like me)
script:
--// Universal Protected Script Fetcher (Luarmor / Panda / Junkie API) \\--
-- Works in most executors (Xeno, Delta, Solara, etc.)

local url = ""  -- <<< PASTE YOUR TARGET URL HERE (e.g., Junkie or Luarmor loader link)

if url == "" then
    warn("❌ No URL set! Paste it into the 'url =' line.")
    return
end

local scr
local ok, result = pcall(function()
    return game:HttpGet(url, true)  -- true = bypass cache for fresh fetch
end)

if not ok then
    warn("❌ HttpGet failed:", result)
    warn("   Possible reasons: Invalid URL, executor blocks HttpGet, or link expired.")
    return
end

scr = result
local total = #scr
local chunkSize = 16184  -- Safe F9 console limit
local chunks = math.ceil(total / chunkSize)

print(("✅ Script fetched successfully!\n   Size: %d characters | Chunks: %d"):format(total, chunks))

-- Save if writefile available (most good executors have it)
if writefile then
    local fileName = "Fetched_" .. os.date("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S") .. ".lua"  -- Timestamped name
    writefile(fileName, scr)
    print("💾 Saved to executor folder as:", fileName)
    print("   Open your executor files to view/edit it!")
else
    warn("⚠️ writefile not supported – printing chunks to F9 console:")
    for i = 1, total, chunkSize do
        local startIdx = i
        local endIdx = math.min(i + chunkSize - 1, total)
        local chunkNum = math.ceil(i / chunkSize)
        print(("\n--- Chunk %d/%d (chars %d-%d) ---"):format(chunkNum, chunks, startIdx, endIdx))
        print(scr:sub(startIdx, endIdx))
    end
    print("\n✅ All chunks printed – check F9 console!")
end
